messages:
elaine-billing: Heads-up — GreenFleet (acct GF-443) tried to add ACH but the bank rejected micro-deposits. Bank message: "account type mismatch". Customer says they selected 'corporate' in the form.
kevin-support: Oh — thanks. Do we have the original onboarding payload? quick guess: customer might have chosen personal vs business.
kevin-support: @carlos-sales can you confirm what the customer entered during onboarding?
carlos-sales: Confirmed with the customer on the call earlier — they said they used their company account but the routing/account names are individual. They gave EIN though.
omar-payments: Pulling payment logs now. Looks like the ACH instrument was created as type=personal in our vault. Bank returned code R01 + custom message about account type validation at their end.
omar-payments: Micro-deposits attempted: 
```
+0.12
+0.08
```
omar-payments: Our system flagged the instrument and payments-bot scheduled retries.
payments-bot: Automated retry scheduled (id: retry-2026-05-22-001). Plan: 3 attempts over 24h with exponential backoff. Current status: on hold until finance sign-off for manual intervention.
maria-accounts: We should not keep charging retries if bank auto-blocked — risk of more declines. Recommend contacting customer to confirm account classification.
kevin-support: Agreed. Suggested reply to customer: ask them to confirm if the bank account is a business account and provide the exact account holder name on bank records + EIN copy if needed.
elaine-billing: Also propose a manual wire fallback for the current invoice to avoid service interruption. Wire instructions template below — please redact before sending externally: 
```
Bank: Redwood Trust Bank
Acct: 1234567890
Routing: 021000021
Ref: GF-443-INV
```
jess-legal: Before sending wiring details, ensure we have an NDA/KYC doc on file for GreenFleet (customer class: SMB). If we don't have EIN docs, request them.
carlos-sales: I have the EIN on the contract but not a scanned document. I'll ask them to upload a quick PDF.
omar-payments: If customer confirms business account and we update instrument to business type, we can re-initiate micro-deposits. That usually clears within 48 hours.
maria-accounts: For now, change ledger state to "payment_hold_manual" and mark invoice due date freeze to avoid late penalties.
elaine-billing: Done: invoice INV-2026-239 set to payment_hold_manual. Notifying customer in support thread now.
kevin-support: Draft message to customer: 
"Hi — we saw the bank rejected micro-deposits due to an account classification mismatch. Can you confirm the account holder name exactly as it appears at your bank and attach an EIN or bank letter? If you'd prefer, we can accept a one-time wire to avoid disruption — let us know and we'll send wire instructions."
carlos-sales: Sending that now. Will ask for a scan of EIN + a screenshot of the bank account name.
omar-payments: Once they confirm, I can flip the instrument to business and trigger a new micro-deposit cycle. If bank still blocks, we'll request ACH verification with a bank letter or accept wire.
payments-bot: Retry job canceled by user (omar-payments) at 1769123605.
elain-billing: (typo) — meant to say thanks everyone :thumbsup:
carlos-sales: Customer replied: "We uploaded an EIN PDF and bank letter. Account is a corporate checking under GreenFleet LLC." They also asked for wire instructions.
kevin-support: Great — proceed with wire fallback. Omar, after wire is received, mark the invoice PAID and we can let them resume service.
omar-payments: Will monitor incoming wire. Also scheduling re-attempt for ACH after 48h once bank letter processed.
maria-accounts: FYI I've logged an internal ticket FIN-3521 to track classification mismatches and to see if our onboarding form needs a clarifying hint.
jess-legal: I'll add a short clause about required bank docs for ACH setup to the onboarding checklist.
carlos-sales: Customer confirmed they initiated a same-day wire. I updated the support thread.
elaine-billing: Closing loop here — invoice marked awaiting-wire until funds arrive. If wire doesn't land by EOD tomorrow, re-escalate to ops. :ok_hand:
